create_All_augmentation: create an All data augmentation instance with configurable rotation, crop, resize, blur, and flip parameters
sample_params_All: sample random augmentation parameters for a given image using the All class sample_params method
apply_augmentation: apply a randomly selected data augmentation like rotation, crop, resize, or blur to an image tensor
review_DifferentiableDataAugmentation_ba: review the DifferentiableDataAugmentation base class that defines the sample_params and apply interface for subclasses
test_All_call: test the All augmentation class by calling it with an image tensor and sampled parameters
